principles: Preserve the yard-sale planning sequence while removing dependence on generated labels and prices inside the art.
Use colour-coded cards and an in-progress decorated sign board as concrete visual cues.
Keep the established longer Level C story voice and the children's contrasting personalities.

pages.reason: Replaces written SELL, KEEP, and MAYBE labels with colour-coded cards that the image can show clearly.
pages.text: They spent Friday evening sorting everything into three piles. A red card meant sell. A blue card meant keep. A yellow card meant maybe. By nine o'clock, the maybe pile had disappeared.

pages.reason: Shows the children preparing visual materials before an adult adds the small written prices and sign copy.
pages.text: Betty made neat round price stickers. Aiden decorated a large sign board for the front gate with six colours and four big stars. Mum would add the words and prices later.
